rationale: C16 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting framework for the child. The child repeats C16's distinctive formulation requiring agency plans and programs for “all conditions of national emergency, including attack upon the United States,” and closely reproduces its separate limitation reserving authority to implement those plans. This combination of matching scope and operative legal safeguard is material rather than generic. C11 is the next strongest because it supplies closely related civil-defense machinery, including Department of Defense coordination, attack assessment, redelegation, and prior-actions provisions. C07 parallels several substantive transportation functions—resource assessment, planning, priorities, allocations, and claimancy—but lacks C16's close textual and structural correspondence.

shared_material.child_excerpt: shall prepare national emergency plans and develop preparedness programs ... with respect to all conditions of national emergency, including attack upon the United States
shared_material.parent_excerpt: shall be designed to provide for the development of civil-defense and defense-mobilization plans and programs ... to meet all conditions of national emergency, including attack upon the United States
shared_material.explanation: Distinctive near-verbatim statement of the plans' scope and emergency predicate.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Nothing in this order shall be construed as conferring authority ... to put into effect any emergency plan, procedure, policy, program, or course of action prepared or developed pursuant to this order. Such authority is reserved to the President.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Nothing in this order ... shall be construed as conferring authority to put into effect any plan, procedure, policy, program, or other course of action prepared or developed pursuant to this order
shared_material.explanation: The child closely adapts C16's implementation-limitation clause and makes the presidential reservation explicit.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Emergency plans and programs ... shall be developed as an integral part of the continuing activities of the Federal Aviation Agency
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The head of each department and agency assigned civil-defense and defense-mobilization functions ... shall develop the plans and programs there referred to
shared_material.explanation: Both use the same administrative mechanism: assign emergency planning responsibility to the relevant agency while separating planning from activation authority.
